req.title: Update pre-populates form
req.statement: The system shall pre-fill the update form with the existing post's title and body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /<id>/update must pre-fill the update form with the existing post's title and body. Tests must verify: (1) positive — authenticated author sees their post's exact title and body in the rendered HTML; (2) negative — unauthenticated user is redirected (cannot see the form); (3) boundary — post id=1 (lowest seeded id, authored by user 5/James) and a non-existent id return correct responses. Additional cases cover: wrong author gets 403, exact field values appear in HTML, and the response status is exactly 200. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes, exact byte strings from known seed data, and both sides of auth/author checks.

tests.name: test_update_form_prepopulates_title_and_body_for_author
preconditions: Post id=2 has title='Pillow delta willow' and body='Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.' authored by user id=1 (Rahul/stone)
actions: Log in as Rahul (id=1) via POST /auth/login
expected: Response body contains exact title 'Pillow delta willow'
Response body contains exact body text 'Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.'
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_update_form_prepopulates_title_and_body_for_author():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    r = client.get('/2/update')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Pillow delta willow' in r.data
    assert b'Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.' in r.data

test_update_form_prepopulates_title_and_body_for_author()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
